title: SoundGraph score
description: A dynamic score: a playlist of songs, each a multitrack MIDI file whose tracks are given acceptable instruments (SoundGraph patches) and the bounds within which playback may vary them. A score sits above the graph: it names patches by path and their controls by id, and needs nothing of the patch format beyond that. Bars count from 1 and may be fractional. docs/scores.md explains how each field plays.

seed.description: Every random choice comes from this, the song's id and the track's index: the same seed plays the same take.

patch_root.description: Where instrument patch paths start, relative to this file. Empty or absent: the repository's examples/patches.

midi.description: A Standard MIDI File (format 0 or 1), relative to this file.

loop.description: Play forever. Tracks with loopStart/loopEnd markers loop between them, each on its own; otherwise the whole song loops at its end, rounded up to a bar. Absent means true.

parts.description: Named sections. A part runs from its from_bar to the next part's from_bar.

instruments.description: The acceptable instruments, picked at random by weight.

change.description: Change instrument mid-song: after a hold of min_bars to max_bars (drawn at random), at the track's next rest. Absent: the instrument picked at the start plays on (unless a part's list leaves it out).

vary.description: Bounds that apply whichever instrument plays: a control id every candidate shares, or gain_db (the track's level, as an offset in dB).

ramps.description: Authored automation, keyed like vary (a control id, node:parameter, or gain_db). A ramp wins over a vary on the same key.

track.description: The MIDI track: its chunk index in the file (0 is the first chunk, often a format 1 file's conductor track).

parts.description: Per part, fields that replace the track's own while that part plays.

patch.description: A patch file, relative to patch_root.

preset.description: One of the patch's presets, applied when it loads.

weight.description: How often it is picked against the others. Absent means 1.

vary.description: Keyed by one of the patch's control ids, or node:parameter for a patch without controls. Each value glides between random targets in [min, max] at a random speed in [rate_min, rate_max].

min.description: In the control's units, inside its declared range.

rate_min.description: Fraction of [min, max] per bar. 0 lets it rest.

rate_max.description: Both absent or 0: picked once when the instrument starts, then held.

phrase.description: Drops the track out and brings it back on a repeating pattern, the way house and techno do. A step is on (A) or off (B).

unit.description: One step: a quarter-note beat, half a bar, or a bar. Absent means bar.

pattern.description: A, x, 1 are on; B, -, ., 0 are off; spaces and bar lines are only for the eye. Repeats.

in.description: How the track comes back. Absent means cut.

out.description: How it drops out. Absent means cut.

ramp.description: Ramp length, in steps. Absent means 1.

from_bar.description: Where the pattern starts. Absent: the start of the part it belongs to, or bar 1.

repeat_bars.description: Start over this many bars after the first point. 0: hold the last value.

points.description: [bar, value] pairs. Held before the first and after the last.
